behaviour: Answer each question plainly with your facts, one answer per turn.
name: Arjun Mehta

behaviour: Give two or more of your facts in one turn whenever you can, even before you're asked for them.
name: Sneha Rao

behaviour: The first time you're asked to choose between options, name two of them and say you can't decide. When asked to pick one, pick the one in your facts. Otherwise answer normally.
name: Vikram Singh

behaviour: For the slot in FIRST_SAID, first give that wrong value. A turn or two later, or when the agent reads your details back, say it was wrong and give the right value from your facts.
name: Ananya Patel

behaviour: Ask your two QUESTIONS, one at a time, at moments that fit (before answering, or after). Then carry on answering with your facts.
name: Rohan Kapoor
questions: What are the tuition fees for the Executive MBA?
Can I get a guaranteed scholarship if I score high on the entrance test?

behaviour: You're in a hurry and often cut the agent off. Answer as soon as you understand what's being asked.
name: Priya Joshi

behaviour: Answer the questions, but at the main decision (when asked to book, confirm, join or agree) say no. Decline any other offer too, politely.
name: Manish Gupta

behaviour: Answer the first two questions, then ask to talk to a real person. Insist if needed.
name: Lakshmi Nair
